*yaswrap* is the PL source code wrapping and encryption tool for YashanDB. The wrapped and encrypted text generated by the tool can be executed normally within the YashanDB database.

The *yaswrap* tool itself does not perform syntax checking on the statements in the input file, and it determines the start and end of PL using the create or replace statement and '/'. The PL objects that can be wrapped and encrypted by *yaswrap* include:

- Package head
- Package body
- Function
- Procedure

For other objects, such as triggers, they can be encapsulated within a procedure first, and then wrapped and encrypted through that procedure.

Using the *yaswrap* tool depends on some environment configuration items (which are usually configured when installing YashanDB). The specific configuration items are as follows:

|Configuration Item |Description |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| LD_LIBRARY_PATH    | yaswrap depends on libyascli.so and libyas_infra.so, usually located under \${YASDB_HOME}/lib. Set the following environment variable: <br> export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=\${YASDB_HOME}/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH} |
| PATH               | The default location of yaswrap is under \${YASDB_HOME}/bin. Set the following environment variable: <br> export PATH=\${YASDB_HOME}/bin:${PATH} |
